description: Selectable card that previews a single diagram template, showing its thumbnail (or an initial-letter placeholder), localized name, localized category chip and up to three tags clamped to two lines. Click or Space raises OnClick (select); double-click or Enter raises OnActivateRequest (create immediately — the gallery wires it to create without the footer detour); used to populate the template gallery grid.

parameters.name: OnClick
parameters.description: Raised once per selection activation: mouse click or Space.

parameters.name: OnActivateRequest
parameters.description: Raised once per creation activation: double-click or Enter (repeat-guarded).
